source: After logging out, Sam only had the energy to take a quick shower, then quickly fell into his bed.
target: Postquam sessionem clausit, Sam tantum vires habuit ad celerem ablutionem, deinde celeriter in lectum cecidit.

source: Waking up the next day, he did a little housework, a grocery run (there were options to order in, but he wanted to spend at least a little bit of time outside of his apartment), and the usual exercises to keep his body in working condition.
target: Sequenti die evigilans, parva opera domestica peragebat, cibaria emere (quamquam optiones ordinandi erant, sed paulum temporis extra habitationem suam degere volebat), atque exercitia solita ad corpus in bona conditione conservandum.

source: He couldn’t wait until the game got popular enough that they would set the playing hours for everybody because this kind of chaotic living, even with his exercises and healthy food, was taking a toll on his body.
target: Non poterat expectare donec ludus satis popularem redditus esset, ut omnibus horae ludi statuerentur, quoniam talis vita tumultuosa, etiam cum exercitiis et cibo sanato, corpus eius opprimebat.

source: Plopping down in front of his computer, he reluctantly opened the forums for the game as well as several gaming sites that dealt with Magic Unbound, where prominently on the main pages were the posts that celebrated the continuously growing population of the game.
target: Ante computatrum suum se consedens, aversus forum ludi atque plura loca ludicra de Magic Unbound aperuit, ubi in paginis principalibus clare ostendebantur commentarii quae populum ludici in continuo crescere celebrabant.

source: Consequently, the forums were full of posts that cursed the crowded beginner villages as well as the increasing prices due to the demand that so many players made on the system that serviced said villages.
target: Ergo fora plena erant commentariorum maledicentium oppida novicorum congesta, atque pretia crescentia propter exigentiam tot lusorum in systemate, quod illa oppida subministrabat.

source: When Sam read these notes, he had to take a minute to curse as he had planned to set up a simple Merchant company that would provide said goods to these villages and ride the wave of new players.
target: Cum Sam has notas legeret, paulisper obscurare oportuit, quoniam consilium habebat instituendi societatem mercatoriolam simplicem, quae illis oppidis merces suppeditaret et fluctum novorum lusorum sectaret.

source: But now, probably due to his own actions, it was too late.
target: At nunc, fortasse ob suas ipsius actiones, iam sero erat.

source: If the mainstream portals were talking about it, then those who could see the trends were already making money off of it.
target: Si portae principales de ea disserebantur, tunc illi qui inclinationes videre poterant, iam ex ea lucrum faciebant.

source: He would need to focus his efforts somewhere else.
target: Necesse erat eum opera sua alibi impendere.

source: It still felt rather shitty.
target: Adhuc pessime videbatur.

source: In the novels that he had read in his past life, the main character always managed to ride economic waves; always finding the best moment to buy or sell something and here he was, watching as an opportunity vanished in front of him like a fart in the wind.
target: In fabulis quas in vita praeterita legerat, heros principalis semper fluctus oeconomicos navigare potuit; semper optimum momentum aliquid emendi vel vendendi inveniens, et ecce, hic aspexit, ut occasio coram eo evanuerit sicut flatus in vento.

source: Still, it wasn’t the end of the world.
target: Attamen, non erat finis mundi.

source: Exploiting the beginners was one of the things that he planned to use for the creation of his economic foundation in the game, but it wasn’t the only one.
target: Exploitatio novitorum erat una ex rebus, quas consilium retulisset ad fundamentum oeconomicum in ludo constituendum, sed non unica erat.

source: And with how the Silvercrest family quest was going, he suspected that his next several steps would become much easier.
target: Et cum iter familiae Silvercrest procedebat, suspicabatur proximos gradus suos multo facilius futurum esse.

source: The rest of the forums were filled with discussion of every facet of the game, mostly positive, though there was a loud minority who were decrying the complexity and difficulty of the skill system.
target: Reliqua fora plena erant disputatione de omni parte ludi, plerumque positiva, quamquam minoritas strepitosa complexitatem et difficultatem systematis peritiae condemnabat.

source: Though after a cursory look, Sam found that universally the answer to those posts was: ‘git gud noob’.
target: Sed post brevem conspectum, Sam invenit responsum universale in illis commentariis esse: ‘Age melius, ineptule’.

source: He had to agree.
target: Consentire debebat.

source: The skill system of the game wasn’t the easiest, but with a bit of practice and elbow grease, one could learn it without trouble.
target: Systema peritiae ludi non erat facillimum, sed cum parva exercitatione et labore diligenti, id quisque sine difficultate discere poterat.

source: It was the definition of easy to learn, hard to master, once again demonstrating that the developers of the game were thinking in the long term.
target: Id erat exemplum: facile discendum, sed difficile dominandum; iterum ostendebat evolutores ludi in longum tempus cogitare.

source: Of course, there were already videos popping up from experts and experts who were analyzing the emerging economic situation in the game.
target: Certe, iam videa apparuere ex peritis, qui condicionem oeconomicam emergentem in ludo analysabant.

source: Sam checked out a few videos, but he didn’t see anything he didn’t know, so he simply closed them.
target: Sam pauca videa inspiciens, nihilignotum reperit, itaque ea simpliciter clausit.

source: He had better things to do with his time.
target: Meliora erant res ad faciendum tempore suo.

source: Finally, he checked his account on the Shadowland website, but his mailbox was full of people wanting to buy the Life of Blood skill book and other extremely rare, or common skill books that nobody knew where to get.
target: Denique rationem suam in situ Shadowland inspiciens, animadvertit epistularum loculum plenum esse hominum qui librum peritiae "Life of Blood" ac alias peritiae libros, sive rari sive vulgares, emere vellebant, quos nemo sciebat unde compararet.

source: Sam thought about exploiting this and selling a few books for a quick buck, but in the end, he decided it wasn’t worth the risk.
target: Sam de hoc cogitavit ut exploiteret et paucos libros ad celerem lucrum venderet, sed denique decrevit non id periculi esse dignum.

source: He built himself up as a trustworthy and fair information broker and exploiting his customers would only cause him grief in the long term.
target: Se aedificavit ut mercator informationum fidus et iustus, atque abusus clientium suorum ei in longo tempore tantum dolorem afferret.

source: Then, stretching a little, listening as his back popped satisfyingly, he returned to his gaming couch and began the login process.
target: Tum, paulum se extendens, dum audiebat dorsi sonum satisfaciens, rediit ad solium ludi suum et processum conectionis incipiebat.

source: The room he stayed in was still the same as he left it, with only Lucky having moved around while he was logged out, turning around in the bed.
target: Camera in qua mansit adhuc eadem erat quam reliquit, cum solum Lucky, dum sessionem finisset, circa lectum versaretur.

source: This resulted in him ‘waking’ up to a mouthful of the wolf’s tail.
target: Hoc efficit ut evigillarer, accipiendo in ore ictum caudae lupae.

source: Spitting hairs out, he sent a half-hearted glare at the pitifully whining wolf that seemed to be growing at an accelerated pace, already reaching the size of a medium-sized pony.
target: Exspuens, miserabiliterque, misit semiduosum aspectum ad miserrimum lupum querulentem, qui videbatur celeriter crescere, iam ad magnitudinem equi mediocris pervenire.

source: ‘I wonder how big he will get.’ He wondered while he checked his equipment and status screen.
target: ‘Miror, quam magnis fies.’ miratus est, dum instrumenta sua et indicem status examinat.

source: Instead of going downstairs for breakfast, he simply began munching on his rations and began practicing his spells.
target: Pro descendendo ad ientaculum, simpliciter incipiebat cibaria sua manducare et incantationes exercere.

source: “Healing Wind!”
target: “Ventus Sanans!”

source: Calling out, he watched with his senses and Mage Sight as the mana formed into the spell and left his hand; it swirled around Lucky, in a translucent, slightly green-tinged wind, then it sunk into him without any fanfare or effect as the wolf was fully healthy and well-rested.
target: Clamans, sensibus suis et Visu Magico intuens, vidit mana in incantationem coalescere et manum eius relinquere; circa Lucky circumvolavit in vento translucido, paulo viridi tincto, deinde in eum submersum est sine ullo strepitu, cum lupus plene sanus et bene quietus esset.

source: Lucky bore being selected as target practice very well.
target: Lucky valde bene tulit quod electus esset ad exercitationem scopum.

source: Sam repeated it several times, trying to get used to the feeling until he could manage the spell without yelling out its name, earning himself several levels in the spell.
target: Sam id pluries repetivit, conatus assuefacere se sensui, donec incantationem sine nomine exclamare posse constituit, qua plures gradus sibi adeptus est.

source: Finally, he stood in the middle of the room, eyes closed, meditating slightly as the healing winds swirled around him.
target: Denique in medio cellae stetit, oculis clausis, leviter meditans, dum venti sanantes circa eum circumvolitabantur.

source: He kept up with it for a few minutes, but as he felt he was sufficiently familiar with this low-tier spell, he finally let up with the casting and watched as the last of the greenish wind sunk into his body.
target: Hoc per paucos minutos secutus est, sed quoniam sensit se incantationis huius inferioris gradu satis notum habere, tandem incantandi cessavit et observavit ut ultimus ventus viridulo in corpus eius infunderetur.

source: Letting out a satisfied smile, as healing spells if you weren’t specialized in them, were rather rare in lower levels.
target: Satis laetitia efferens, cum incantationes sanantes, nisi in eis specialiter instructus, in gradibus inferioribus rarae erant.

source: Using Healing Wind, he now had a few opportunities to acquire even stronger spells.
target: Per Ventum Sanantem, nunc aliquot occasiones habebat ad incantationes fortiores adipisci.

source: Then he turned his attention towards one of the other spells he had just gained thanks to completing the sub-quest.
target: Tum sensum suum attulit ad unam ex aliis incantationibus, quam nuper ex subquaestionis expletis adeptus erat.

source: Taking up a silly pose, leaning slightly back, head tilted down, arms crossed in front of him and his finger formed into random gang symbols, exclaimed.
target: Statu inepto assumpto, paululum recuens, capite deorsum inclinato, brachiis ante se transpositis, et digito in figuras fortuitas coetus replicandas formans, exclamat.

source: “Shadow Mirage!”
target: “Illusio Umbrarum!”

source: There was a brief burst of mana moving around in his body then it was expelled and formed into first a copy of him out of shadows then a fraction of a second later that shadow gained definition and color and thus there were two of him standing in the room in a silly pose.
target: Brevis effusio manae per corpus eius circumacta est; deinde expulsa, primum exemplar eius ex umbris constitutum, deinde paulo post, illa umbra definitionem et colorem accepit, ita ut duo eius in cella in inepto habitu stanterent.

source: Chuckling slightly, he let go of the pose and began walking around the Mirage as it kept standing there, still as a rock.
target: Exrisus leviter, deposuit statum ineptum et circum Illusio ambulare coepit, dum illa ibi stabat immota sicut saxa.

source: The replicated detail on the mirage was amazing, as he could see individual hairs on his arms, but the stillness was still annoying.
target: Detalii replicati in illusione prodigiosi erant, cum capillos singulos in brachiis videre posset, sed tamen immobilitas vexabat.

source: Although he knew that with enough practice with the skill, they would soon learn (that is, the game system would learn their behavior pattern and fighting style) and would begin to move.
target: Quamquam sciebat, cum satis exercitationis peritiae adsisset, cito didicerent (id est, systema ludi mores ac rationem certandi percepisset) et movere inciperent.

source: But for now, it would be enough to play with the mind of any enemy he came across.
target: Sed nunc, satis erat ut mente cuiusque hostis, quem obveniret, ludere posset.

source: He reached out and tried to touch the mirage but his hand went through the spell and not a moment later the entire thing burst into motes of sparkling mana and shadows, falling to the ground and vanishing entirely.
target: Manum protendit et illud illusorium tangere temptavit, sed manus eius per incantationem transiit, et paulo post totum in micantes particulas manae et umbrarum dissolutum est, in terram cecidens atque penitus evanuit.

source: Nodding to himself, he spent a few minutes memorizing how the spell worked so as not to have to yell the names of the spells, then turned towards Lucky.
target: Se iactans, paucos minutos didicit quomodo incantatio operaretur, ut nomen incantationum non clamaret, deinde ad Lucky se vertit.

source: Sam got on his knees, hugged the wolf to himself, and began murmuring.
target: Sam genua flectit, lupum se complexus est, et submurmuravit.

source: “Okay, Lucky. This is important, so pay attention! I want you…”
target: “Bene, Lucky. Hoc est grave, ergo attende! Te volo…”

source: Heading towards the Silvercrest Manor, dressed in his adventurer clothes, forgoing his Sunday’s best, because he fully expected that one way or another this entire thing would end in a fight, Sam watched with a satisfied smile as the entire city was in a tizzy.
target: Dirigens ad Silvercrest Manerium, indutus vestimentis exploratoris suae, optimas vestes dominicas omittens, quoniam plene exspectabat rem istam in pugnam ducendam esse, Sam cum risu contento spectabat, dum tota urbs in tumultu versabatur.

source: Harried guards walked around, paranoidly looking at everybody, even at each other.
target: Custodes solliciti circumambulabant, omnes spectantes, etiam inter se.

source: Players belonging to guilds were doing the same thing, deadeye-ing people from other guilds, and fights could be seen breaking out everywhere, causing the already agitated guards to become even more stressed.
target: Lusores, qui ad collegia pertinebant, idem agebant, homines ex aliis collegiis intuentes, et pugnae ubique eruptae videbantur, quo custodes iam excitati etiam magis solliciti fierent.

source: Apparently, his little distraction worked really well…
target: Apparuit parva distractione eius vere optime processisse…

source: Cutting through the last alley before approaching the manor directly, he made eye contact with one of the urchins and gave them a small thumbs up.
target: Perveniens per ultimam angustum viam, antequam manerium directe appropinquaret, oculos contulit cum uno ex vagis pueris et parvum digitum levatum dedit.

source: The smile he received in return sent shivers down his spine.
target: Risus reciprocus quem accepit, tremores per dorsum eius intulit.

source: ‘Why do I do this to myself?’ he lamented, continuing his journey.
target: ‘Cur hoc mihi facio?’ lamentatus est, iter suum continuans.

source: Arriving in front of the manor, he was about to announce himself, but the gates immediately opened and one of the guards stepped out for a moment, looked around nervously, and then bade him to follow him with a respectful nod.
target: Ad manerium perveniens, se praedicere paratus erat, sed portae statim apertae sunt et unus ex custodibus paulisper exiit, circumspiciens anxie, deinde ei signum dedit ut sequeretur, cum capite reverenter inclinato.

source: Sam said nothing, just followed him.
target: Sam nihil dixit; tantum eum secutus est.

source: Inside, he was met by a familiar butler.
target: Intus eum occurrit minister domesticus cognitus.

source: “Greetings, good sir. I hope you returned with excellent news!”
target: “Salve, bone vir. Spero te rediisse cum nuntiis praeclaris!”

source: The man’s voice was the patented, even butler voice, but Sam could still hear the undercurrent of worry.
target: Vox viri erat exemplar ministerii domestici, sed Sam tamen subsonum sollicitudinis audire poterat.

source: He gave him a smile and a nod.
target: Ei risum dedit atque caput inclinavit.

source: “Indeed. I got the item.”
target: “Certe, rem adeptus sum.”

source: The butler let out a relieved sigh, and Sam could hear the nearby guards doing the same thing.
target: Minister domesticus leviter suspiravit, et Sam audire potuit custodes proximos idem facere.

source: Apparently, they were rather loyal. ‘Or good actors…’
target: Apparuit eos esse fidelissimos. ‘Vel boni histriones…’

source: “Follow me, then, Sir,” came the clipped reply from the older man.
target: “Sequere me, domine,” venit brevis responsum a viro seniore.

source: He turned elegantly on his heels and began marching towards the manor proper with a pep in his steps.
target: Eleganter in pedibus versatus, se vertit et ad manerium proprium cum vivacitate in passibus incedere coepit.

source: Sam followed him, one hand on his sword and his senses strained to the maximum.
target: Sam eum secutus est, una manu gladio suo tenens, et sensibus suis ad summum excitatis.

source: It was the best time to ambush them…
target: Optimum tempus erat ut eos insidiarentur…

source: Surprisingly, nobody attacked them on the way to the garden where he had his talk with Lord Silvercrest not so long ago.
target: Mirum, nemo eos oppugnare conatus est in via ad hortum, in quo non multo tempore cum Domino Silvercrest colloquium habuerat.

source: Arriving at the well-taken-care-of garden, he immediately understood why the butler took him there.
target: Ad hortum bene curatum perveniens, statim intellexit cur minister domesticus eum illuc duxisset.

source: Where before pristine grass delighted those who visited the manor, now it was covered by a giant slab of thin rock.
target: Ubi ante herba purissima eos qui manerium visitabant delectabat, nunc ingenti lamina tenuis lapidis operiebatur.

source: Carved into the rock were runes, some he recognized, some he didn’t.
target: In lapide incisi erant runae, quarum nonnullas agnoscit, alias non.

source: The runes were in a circle, and inside the circle was a triangle.
target: Runae in circulo erant, et intra circulum triangulum constitutum erat.

source: And the points of the triangle stood three things.
target: Et in verticibus trianguli stabant tres res.

source: The nearest to him contained a small stone plinth, also carved with runic symbols, obviously the intended place of the chalice.
target: Proximum ad eum continebat parvum plinthum lapideum, quo etiam runae incisae erant, manifestum loco calicem destinatum esse.

source: The farthest from him was occupied with a distinguished gentleman in high-quality robes, leaning on a staff that seemed to be radiating magic and perusing a leather-bound notebook with great interest.
target: Eum remotissimum occupabat vir distinguendus, indutus vestimentis praestantissimis, innixus baculo, qui magicam radiare videbatur, et commentarium coriaceum magno studio perlegebat.

source: On the last point was a very simple divan, basically a slab of wood with minimal upholstery and four legs.
target: In ultimo vertice stabat divanus simplex, constitutus ex laminis ligneis cum pauca ornamenta et quattuor cruribus.

source: On it laid the lady of the house, deathly pale, and Sam could see the beads of sweat flowing down her face.
target: Super illum iacebat domina domus, mortu pallidissima, et Sam globulos sudoris e facie eius fluentes videre poterat.

source: The moment he stepped into the garden, every eye in the vicinity was directed at him, including the Lord’s.
target: Statim, cum in hortum intravit, omnes oculi in vicinia ad eum directi erant, etiam Domini.

source: “Adventurer!” came the excited yell, but Sam could see that the Lord was just trying to keep up the façade as his eyes always kept darting at his wife.
target: “Advenator!” inquit voce excitata, sed Sam animadvertit Dominum tantum speciem retinere conari, nam oculi eius semper ad uxorem eius versa erant.

source: “I hope you returned bringing great news!”
target: “Spero te rediisse cum nuntiis praeclaris!”

source: Instead of replying, Sam just reached inside his inventory and retrieved the Chalice of Restraint.
target: Sam, potius quam respondens, intra repositum suum accessit et Calicem Continentiae extraxit.

source: There were multiple gasps of surprise, predominantly from the wizard at the runic circle and another happy one from Lord Silvercrest.
target: Plura suspiria admirationis fiebant, praesertim a mago iuxta circulum runarum, atque alia laeta a Domino Silvercrest.

source: “Ha ha ha! Yes! Most excellent, my friend!”
target: “Ha ha ha! Ita! Praestantissimum, amice!”

source: Taking several giant steps the large man arrived next to Sam and gently took the Chalice from him, holding it in his giant hand gently, and with great care walked it over to the wizard who accepted the artifact with the same care, placing it on the plinth.
target: Vir magnus, compluribus ingentibus passibus, ad Sam accessit et leniter Calicem ab eo abstulit, eam in manu gigantea tenerens, et cum summa cura ad magum perrexit, qui artificium eodem modo accepit, super plinthum deposuit.

source: “Let us commence the ritual!”
target: “Ritualem incipiamus!”

source: The wizard silently nodded, and the runic circle instantly lit up.
target: Magus tacite annuit, et circulus runarum statim illuminatus est.

source: Then the plinth and the Chalice of Restraint began to blaze with very familiar white flames.
target: Tum plinthus et Calix Continentiae incipiebant ardere cum ignibus albis, notis valde familiaribus.

source: Following that, a dome of blue sprung up around the ritual while everybody else watched with bated breath.
target: Postea, domus caerulea circa ritum erupit, dum omnes alii, spiritu retento, spectabant.

source: Sam stepped up to the Lord, whose eyes were glued to his wife’s slumped form.
target: Sam accessit ad Dominum, cuius oculi ad formam prostratam uxoris eius fixi erant.

source: “Are you expecting an attack, sir?”
target: “An impetum exspectas, domine?”

source: The Lord answered without moving his eyes.
target: Dominus respondit, oculos non mutans.

source: “Indeed, my young friend. I even sent my daughter away with a trusted friend.”
target: “Certe, mi iuvenis amice. Etiam filiam meam cum amico fideli misi.”

source: “Good, then I don’t have to convince you to prepare for one.”
target: “Bene, ergo non oportet me te persuadere ut ad impetum praeparas.”

source: The older man chuckled a little and sent him a small smirk.
target: Vir senior parum subridens ei parvum signum dedit.

source: “Fret not, my friend. I know very well what my enemies are capable of!”
target: “Noli sollicitari, mi amice. Bene scio quid hostes mei efficere possint!”

source: Sam nodded, then refocused on his senses.
target: Sam annuit, deinde sensibus suis iterum intendens.

source: His first target was the ritual, curious about it.
target: Prima meta eius erat ritus, de quo curiosus erat.

source: However, it seemed that it was rather simple.
target: Attamen, videbatur satis simplex esse.

source: The wizard was directing with the help of the runic circle the magic of a minor ley line into the chalice and then would probably use that to extract the parasite from the lady of the house.
target: Magus, adiuvatus circulo runarum, magiam ex parva linea arcana in calicem directabat, atque deinde id probabiliter ad extrahendum parasitum ex domina domus adhiberet.

source: He made sure to take a look at the runes (after toggling the recording software on with a small movement of his fingers) for later study, then directed his senses towards the walls of the manor as that was the easiest point of entry.
target: Curo est ut runas inspiceret (post parvum motum digitorum suorum, programmatum recordationis activatum) ad studium ulterius, deinde sensus suos versus muros manerii direxit, quod erat facillimum ingressus punctum.

source: He didn’t have to look long.
target: Non diutius inspicere necesse fuit.

source: The moment his senses went further than the wall, he sensed the build-up of foreign mana.
target: Momento quo sensus eius ultra muros pervenerunt, cumulatum mana alienum sensit.

source: Sighing audibly, he unsheathed his blade, ignored the tensing guards standing around, as well as the fearful maids, and turned towards the wall.
target: Suspirans audibiliter, gladium extraxit, custodum vigiles circumstantium nec non ancillas timidas neglexit, et versus murum se vertit.

source: “What are you doin–” came the question from the Lord, but he was silenced by a loud yell and the sound of something shattering. Probably the defenses of the manor.
target: “Quid facis–” inquit Dominus, sed ille a voce alta et strepitu rei discidentis silentus factus est. Probabiliter defensiones manerii.

source: “ATTACK!”
target: «IMPUGNATE!»

source: Before anyone could react Sam beaned the first attacker jumping over the wall in the head with a well timed Wind Bullet which caused everyone to freeze for a moment as they watched the man tumble to the ground, where he lay, still.
target: Priusquam quisquam reagere posset, Sam primum oppugnatorem, qui super murum insiliens, in capite percussit acerto Proiectili Venti, quo omnes paulisper immobiles facti sunt, dum vir ad terram lapsus, ubi immotus iacebat, spectabant.

source: Then, as one, everyone began moving, and it was chaos.
target: Tum omnes simul movere coeperunt, et chaos praevaluit.
